description: A state variable filter with a nonlinear stage in its loop, giving lowpass, bandpass and highpass at once and breaking up as it is driven

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, 256Hz to 23170Hz as a power of two
Attenuates the voltage at the Freq jack before it is added to the Freq knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets the Q, 0.5 to 20, which narrows the band and sharpens the ring at the cutoff
Attenuates the voltage at the Q jack before it is added to the Q knob, 0 to 1
Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the nonlinear stage, 0 to 1, which is what makes the filter unstable
Attenuates the voltage at the Drv jack before it is added to the Drv knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The signal to be filtered, one per channel
Modulates the cutoff, one octave per volt scaled by the Freq CV knob
Modulates the Q, a tenth per volt scaled by the Q CV knob
Modulates the drive, a tenth per volt scaled by the Drive CV knob

outputs.text: The signal below the cutoff, with its constant offset removed
The band around the cutoff, with its constant offset removed
The signal above the cutoff, with its constant offset removed

notes: the cutoff is held between 2Hz and four tenths of the sample rate however far the knob and the jack push it
menu: Nonlinear mode — picks the curve the drive is pushed through: Tanh, Hard Clip, Sin, Overdrive, Exp, Sqr or Abs

inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Freq knob alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0.5 to 20V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
